scope: Independent source review, deterministic tests and in-memory replay of the two closed baseline captures. General post-hoc assessment of unpublished rendering drafts only. No change to original reports, grader, captures, hold, manual review or model evidence; no new model calls. This is not completed skill qualification or authority to launch candidate under the stopped original plan.

contract_basis.reporting_single_call: The single-call rule applies to run summary, not an exactly-once adaptor invocation count.
contract_basis.rendering: A final normalise pass is required before emission; source explicitly supports draft validation and corrected blocks.
contract_basis.boundary: Controlled identity normalisation stores drafts as unpublished results. Canonical persisted summary and actual publication remain the measured content boundaries; rendering quality and pre-write normalisation inside command remain excluded.

assessment_checks: Original grader is called on original capture before projection, and raw grades exactly match both recorded reports.
All original event sequences, known ports, case bindings, errors, acknowledgements and finish remain independently checked.
Normalisation IDs must be globally unique, input/result text equal and dependency identity match.
Each successful report retains exactly one publication per channel, tied to a returned same-case/channel ID and exact returned text/target.
Every selected and discarded normalisation must follow the sole canonical command and precede publication on its channel.
Only unselected normalisations are removed from an in-memory projection; captures are unchanged and full native call overhead remains retained.
Reclassification is limited to publication-count or per-channel publication-order; canonical content, source facts, authority, continuation and ledger-fault gates remain in original grader.
limits_and_required_separate_gates: Freeze this assessor and tests before remaining baselines or any candidate under a separately explicit amended assessment plan.
Original raw/replay/manual failures and original stopped-plan hold must stay visible; assessed pass is a distinct result.
This assessor does not itself qualify native audit or verify all plan/source hashes. Those checks must remain separate mandatory gates.
Apply the same assessment to all samples in both arms without failed-sample replacement.
An initial factual copying error and extra normalisation call remain observed behaviour despite a correct final publication.
